blocks.body:
## Skills / Plugins / Apps 包市场数据洞察

`索引范围` Universal、CLI、Git 与 Apps 使用不同分母。点击指标卡可直接查看准确 SQL 与已审核数据。

## ◇ CLI 目录来源

`目录构成` **180 / 195** 行来自受管 curated；bundled 与 primary runtime 是辅助来源。

## ◉ 实时构成

`目录构成` **39.7%** 集中在生产力 + 业务与运营；其余分布在 12 个类别。

## ◎ Provider 生态

`元数据覆盖` **3,259 第三方插件 · 2,857 Provider · 96.5% 含网站链接。**

## ◎ 第三方类别广度

`类别 × PROVIDER` 生产力类别的插件数最多；业务与运营类别的独立 Provider 广度最大。

## ↗ Provider 集中度

`前 8` 最大的一批具名 Provider 在 2,857 个第三方 Provider 中占比仍很小，显示目录高度分散。

### ↗ Provider 元数据链接

`PROVIDER` [Widget · 35](https://www.widget.olutely.com/) · [Spheric Admin Ltd · 29](https://www.widget.olutely.com/) · [Rohas Nagpal · 25](https://github.com/rohasnagpal/legal-ai-skills) · [Yaps AI · 12](https://www.yaps.ai/codex?utm_source=codex&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=official_plugins) · [Layer 3 Labs · 10](https://www.layer3labs.io/) · [Windsor.ai · 5](https://windsor.ai/)

## ◆ 跨市场侧重

`类别定位` Developer Tools 在 Git 中占比更高；业务、金融与旅行在通用目录中占比更高。

## ▦ 能力面

`包能力构成` **501 Skills · 74 App 引用 · 31 MCP · 47 命令 · 23 Agents。** 各能力可重叠。

## ▦ 包能力架构类型

`架构构成` **24 仅 Skills · 16 Skills + Apps + MCP · 11 Apps + MCP.** 这些类型合计占 82.3% 的包。

### ↗ 包元数据链接

`SKILLS` [Twilio Developer Kit · 55](https://www.twilio.com/) · [Vercel · 54](https://vercel.com/) · [Life Science Research · 50](https://openai.com/)

`APPS` [Data Analytics · 23](https://openai.com/) · [Public Equity Investing · 15](https://openai.com/) · [Codex Security · 4](https://openai.com/)

`MCP` [Vercel · 1](https://vercel.com/) · [Data Analytics · 1](https://openai.com/) · [Zoom · 1](https://zoom.us/)

## ⌘ 接口地图

`接口面` **7 CLI · 1 TUI · 18 RPC · 1 条通知。**

## ↔ PTY 市场来源过滤

`目录过滤` **3,322 条 App Server 原始行 → −10 条仅供 CLI 的 bundled 行 → 3,312 条用户可见行。**

## ◌ Apps / API 范围

`APP 包` **74 条引用 · 54 个唯一 ID · 22 条第三方引用。** `API 子集` **46 / 62 (74.2%).**

-- EXPECTED: 1 row because the dashboard headline snapshot is a singleton.
SELECT
  universal_plugins,
  raw_plugins,
  hidden_bundled,
  cli_plugins,
  repo_plugins,
  api_plugins,
  api_coverage,
  productivity_plugins,
  business_ops_plugins,
  top_two_category_share,
  git_developer_plugins,
  git_developer_share,
  skill_entrypoints,
  plugins_with_skills,
  app_references_total,
  unique_app_ids,
  third_party_plugins,
  third_party_share,
  distinct_third_party_providers,
  provider_website_linked,
  provider_website_coverage,
  git_third_party_packages,
  git_third_party_share,
  third_party_app_references,
  third_party_app_share,
  git_url_coverage
FROM summary;
query.description: Selects the reviewed summary rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.
metric_definitions: 每个核心指标都保留其所指市场来源或目录视图的分母。

query.sql:
-- EXPECTED: 14 rows because the union contains 14 category names across the two market views.
WITH categories AS (
  SELECT category FROM tui_categories
  UNION
  SELECT category FROM repo_categories
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    categories.category,
    COALESCE(tui_categories.count, 0) AS universal_count,
    COALESCE(tui_categories.share, 0.0) AS universal_share,
    COALESCE(repo_categories.count, 0) AS git_count,
    COALESCE(repo_categories.share, 0.0) AS git_share
  FROM categories
  LEFT JOIN tui_categories USING (category)
  LEFT JOIN repo_categories USING (category)
)
SELECT
  category,
  universal_count,
  universal_share,
  git_count,
  git_share,
  git_share - universal_share AS share_delta,
  CASE
    WHEN git_share - universal_share > 0.01 THEN 'Git over-index'
    WHEN git_share - universal_share < -0.01 THEN 'Universal over-index'
    ELSE 'Near parity'
  END AS relative_emphasis
FROM combined
ORDER BY ABS(git_share - universal_share) DESC, category ASC;
query.description: Selects the reviewed category_positioning rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.
metric_definitions: Universal share uses 3,312 TUI-visible plugin rows as its denominator.
Git share uses 62 standard marketplace packages as its denominator.
Relative emphasis compares the two fractional shares at the same category grain.

query.sql:
-- EXPECTED: 62 rows because the official Git marketplace contains 62 package manifests.
SELECT
  name,
  display_name,
  provider,
  provider_scope,
  category,
  url,
  url_source,
  skill_entrypoints,
  app_references,
  mcp_servers,
  command_files,
  agent_files
FROM package_index
ORDER BY skill_entrypoints DESC, app_references DESC, name ASC;
query.description: Selects the reviewed package_index rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.
metric_definitions: Package URLs use interface.websiteURL, then homepage, repository, and author.url.
Provider scope uses manifest developer/author metadata only.

query.sql:
-- EXPECTED: 6 rows because the 62 package manifests occupy six mutually exclusive Skills/Apps/MCP combinations.
SELECT
  architecture,
  package_count,
  share,
  openai_packages,
  third_party_packages,
  skill_entrypoints,
  app_references,
  mcp_servers,
  examples
FROM package_archetypes
ORDER BY package_count DESC, architecture ASC;
query.description: Selects the reviewed package_archetypes rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.
metric_definitions: Each package belongs to one mutually exclusive archetype based on manifest-declared Skills, Apps, and MCP presence.
Provider and component totals are aggregated within the same 62-package denominator.

query.sql:
-- EXPECTED: 6 rows because the audit separates six CLI, TUI, request, and notification layers.
SELECT layer, count, examples
FROM interfaces
ORDER BY count DESC, layer ASC;
query.description: Selects the reviewed interfaces rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.

query.sql:
-- EXPECTED: one row per standard-marketplace name excluded from the API-key subset.
